files.purpose: Pure selection index and match-setup logic
Character Select screen controller (UI Toolkit + Input System UI map)

integration_notes: Create scene CharacterSelect.unity; add a GameObject with UIDocument (Source Asset = Assets/UI/CharacterSelect.uxml, Panel Settings = Assets/UI/RuralRumblePanelSettings.asset) and CharacterSelectController.
Assign Assets/Data/Wrestlers/WrestlerRoster.asset to the controller's Roster field.
Project-wide Input Actions (InputSystem.actions) must contain a 'UI' map with Navigate (Vector2), Submit, Cancel actions.
Add CharacterSelect scene to Build Settings between Start and Match (names must match SceneNames).
Tests assembly (EditMode) needs references to RuralRumble.UI and RuralRumble.Core.
assumptions: Selected-state scale uses USS 'scale' property (Unity 6 supports it).
BuildSetup picks the other index (0<->1); falls back to the same wrestler if roster has only one.
Overlay is a first child of root with picking ignored; title/row/hint render above it due to document order.
Navigate performed fires on each stick/key actuation; keyboard arrows/WASD and d-pad composites supply x of +/-1.
